name: Beams
author: E. T. Carter
description: Wide angled light bands: two families of broad soft-edged light sheets cross the frame on the diagonal and brighten where they overlap, each a flat plateau of light with a feathered shoulder, a brighter grazing edge and a slow ripple along its length. Every band carries its own palette stop so the crossings blend hues, and the whole lattice sweeps slowly, bands drifting apart and bunching.

params.label: Angle
params.effect: Angle of the main band family in degrees from horizontal; negative rakes down to the right, 0 lays the bands flat, 90 stands them vertical.

params.label: Crossing
params.effect: Angle of the second family relative to the first; 0 stacks both families parallel, 90 crosses them at right angles.

params.label: Bands
params.effect: Number of bands in the main family (the crossing family carries one fewer, wider and softer); low is a couple of wide sweeps, high a dense lattice.

params.label: Width
params.effect: Width of each band as a fraction of frame height; narrow gives crisp light strips, wide floods the frame in overlapping sheets.

params.label: Softness
params.effect: Feathering of the band shoulders; 0 cuts clean-edged strips, 1 melts them into misty gradients.

params.label: Sweep speed
params.effect: Pace of the slow sweep as bands drift apart and bunch; 0 holds the lattice still.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness of the bands; low keeps them as faint sheets, high blows the crossings toward white.
